text: Slow out-breaths tell your body the fight is over.

text: Soon the whole valley will burn, and the pack will need someone to lead them out.

text: Tap ONE THING again whenever you need it.

text: Teaching it is how you know you've got it.

text: That fire in you could make you the greatest hunter this valley has ever seen.

text: That took more courage than any fight.

text: That's a gift, but running flat out all day is exhausting.

text: The pack is far behind now.

text: The Shadow turns away into the dark.

text: Then you wait for my signal.

text: Three more minutes of hunting today, then we rest.

text: Too impatient to hunt, they said.

text: Trust comes back, one calm moment at a time.

text: What you do next is what the pack remembers.

text: Which tool does this moment need?

text: You came to this pack a restless young outsider.

text: You felt it rise, let it pass, and waited for the signal.

text: You found your One Thing before you chose.
